difficulty_reason: The author builds an adaptive finite-ball exploration tailored to ghost-field disconnection and proves a conditional pivotal-probability criterion for stochastic domination. Harris–FKG and the exploration history bound every conditional pivotal probability by magnetization, then the exact parameter comparison and Bayes formula produce the exponential volume inequality on the countably infinite graph. The complete authored comparison construction and induction proofs exceed ordinary qualification calculations of Bernoulli connectivity; this is an advanced proof of a known sharpness bound, not a claim that the bound itself is new.
